baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence تَظُنُّ ... يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ joins cognition, a passive act upon a feminine referent, and the ف ق ر event noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cognition can harden from indication into certainty, the passive verb makes the referent undergo an enacted impact, and the spinal plus calamity branches make that impact support-destroying rather than merely unpleasant.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached after an indication supplies the strongest evidentiary force available for تظن.
Bringing an act into being, including causing something to undergo it, makes the passive verb an enacted impact.
Segmented vertebrae and the possibility of a broken back give the impact a bodily support structure.
A back-breaking calamity converts the spinal image into the event anticipated by the clause.

changed_reading.before: The feminine referent thinks that something bad may happen to it.
changed_reading.after: The referent anticipates, potentially with indication-based certainty, an enacted blow severe enough to break its supporting structure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ظ ن ن in تَظُنُّ and the feminine pronominal site بِهَا remain inside the focus clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The expected-place or sign branch of ظ ن ن allows the referent not only to entertain a prediction but also to function as the place where the predicted calamity is already legible.

activation_trace.role: The expected place or sign of a thing turns the referent into an omen-bearing locus.
An act brought into being supplies the future event whose approach can be registered at that locus.
The back-breaking calamity is the ominous event that the locus appears to forecast.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports an internal expectation.
changed_reading.after: The clause also presents its feminine referent as the visible or situated sign where the coming calamity is anticipated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُفْعَلَ بِهَا governs فَاقِرَةٌ, whose root inventory includes both material need and inward poverty.
baseline_models.mechanism: Instead of naming only a violent blow, the clause can forecast an action that reduces the referent to external need or to an inward condition of greed and non-contentment.

activation_trace.role: An outcome whose reliability is unknown preserves dread about what the reduction will entail.
Causing something to undergo an act supplies the transition into deprivation.
Need and material poverty supply the external result of the passive action.
Inner poverty as greed supplies a parallel affective result, an unfillable lack.

changed_reading.after: The referent fears being actively rendered bereft, materially or inwardly, rather than only being struck.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive form of ف ع ل in يُفْعَلَ بِهَا leaves the actor unspoken while retaining an affected counterpart.
baseline_models.mechanism: The reciprocal-action branch permits the unnamed act to be carried as a counteraction between two sides, although the focus ayah alone does not identify the initiating side or prove reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: Mutual action between two participants supplies a possible action-and-return structure for the passive verb.
Certainty after an indication lets the affected side recognize that a counteraction is approaching.
The back-breaking calamity gives the possible counteraction its severe result.

changed_reading.before: An anonymous one-way calamity will be inflicted.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the passive calamity may be the returning side of an action relation rather than an isolated one-way event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel face clauses resolve the feminine referent and place radiance, observable appearance, and grimacing on a single visual surface. The focus cognition therefore becomes embodied foreknowledge: the face already displays the verdict it expects.

activation_trace.role: The expected place or sign of a thing makes تظن available as recognition registered at a locus.
The back-breaking calamity is the verdict whose approach the visible surface registers.
The face as bodily front resolves بها and provides the public display surface.
Beauty and radiance provide the positive facial state against which the ominous face is read.
A thing becoming visible or fair to an observer reinforces the sequence's concern with legible appearance.
A grimacing face and intense aversion supply the negative expression that precedes the focus prediction.

structural_cues: 75:22-25 forms a matched sequence of two plural face clauses, with the second immediately followed by تظن and بها.
The positive face is radiant and looking, while the negative face is already grimacing before the predicted act is named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel visible face states and the expected-sign branch of ظن; I infer that the grimace functions as embodied foreknowledge of the coming act. A live alternative is that the face is only the pronoun's antecedent and the cognition belongs metonymically to its owner.

changed_reading.before: An unresolved feminine referent internally expects a calamity.
changed_reading.after: A grimacing face visibly bears and announces its own evidence-based expectation of a back-breaking event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier self is inwardly perceptive despite casting excuses, and the later face can stand for that self. Activated by the accusation branch of ظ ن ن, the face's expectation becomes a self-indicting recognition that outward excuses cannot suppress.

activation_trace.role: Accusation and suspicion of guilt let تظن carry a self-indicting edge, not only prediction.
The back-breaking calamity supplies the consequence acknowledged by the self-indictment.
The thing itself or its very identity makes the witness and the accused the same self.
Insight of the heart supplies inward knowledge that persists beneath verbal defenses.
Throwing something away gives the excuses an externalized, defensive motion.
Excuse and apology name the defense that fails to alter inner recognition.
The face standing for the self allows the earlier inward witness to surface bodily in the focus referent.

structural_cues: 75:14-15 juxtaposes self-perception with the casting of excuses.
75:24-25 shifts that conflict onto a face whose expression and cognition cannot be separated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-insight, discarded excuses, face-as-self, and an accusation branch for ظن; I infer that the face accuses its own owner. The live alternative is ordinary fearful expectation without a forensic function.

changed_reading.before: The face fears what will be done to it.
changed_reading.after: The face becomes the self's involuntary witness, recognizing and effectively indicting itself before the back-breaking consequence arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts challenged human calculation with increasingly bodily indications, then repeats ظن in the nearly identical أن-clause at the point of separation. The focus verb consequently moves from vague fear toward compelled certainty after signs.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication provides the epistemic destination of the focus verb.
Supposition or calculation supplies the earlier, challenged mode of human judgment.
The fixed, stunned gaze supplies an embodied indication rather than an abstract premise.
Arrival at an endpoint makes the following cognition a threshold recognition.
The repeated certainty-after-indication branch confirms the focus cognition through a second ظن construction.
Distinguishing and separating two things names the conclusion recognized by the repeated ظن.

structural_cues: 75:3 and 75:36 frame the surah with challenged أَيَحْسَبُ questions.
75:25 تظن أن and 75:28 وظن أنه repeat the same cognition-plus-clause pattern across a three-ayah bodily sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies challenged calculation, bodily signs, and a repeated ظن tied to separation; I infer an epistemic reversal from chosen miscalculation to compelled recognition. The weak-supposition branch of ظن remains materially live.

changed_reading.before: The face merely suspects that a calamity may occur.
changed_reading.after: The face has begun to know from accumulating signs that the predicted rupture is now unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spinal image in فاقرة opens into a body-wide sequence: a limit is reached, separation is recognized, one leg is wrapped with the other, and the body is driven onward. The event is therefore a staged loss of axial support and self-directed movement.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to undergo an act makes the following bodily sequence an enacted transition.
Vertebral segments and a broken back supply the axial structure whose support fails.
The back-breaking calamity turns structural failure into the clause's predicted event.
Reaching the endpoint initiates the terminal bodily progression.
Separation between two things supplies the irreversible rupture within the progression.
Wrapping one thing around another supplies the body's entangled, no-longer-independent limbs.
The leg together with carrying or driving joins the lower body's anatomy to transport.
Driving and herding supply forced onward motion after self-locomotion fails.

structural_cues: 75:25-30 is uninterrupted: predicted فاقرة, reaching the collarbones, recognized separation, paired shanks, then the drive.
The branchless ت ر ق occurrence in 75:26 contributes the collarbone location structurally but is not used as a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spinal fracture, endpoint, separation, wrapped legs, and driving; I infer one propagating axial-collapse process. A live alternative treats these as successive but independent images rather than a single physiology.

changed_reading.before: A severe but isolated blow is expected.
changed_reading.after: The face anticipates the opening of a staged bodily collapse that removes support, separates life, entangles the legs, and ends in forced transport.

context_deltas.mechanism: The broken-back image is extended spatially: flight has no refuge, stable settlement belongs toward the sovereign Lord, and the later drive removes autonomous direction. فاقرة thus collapses both bodily support and the architecture of escape.

activation_trace.role: The broken spinal support supplies the bodily analogue for failed external support.
An exposed back supplies vulnerability when no protective or carrying support remains.
Flight and escape define the movement being sought and then denied.
Refuge names the external support whose absence closes the escape route.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the destination as controlled rather than freely chosen.
Fixity and settlement supply the endpoint opposed to flight.
Driving or herding turns the fixed destination into compelled motion toward it.

structural_cues: 75:10-12 moves from the question of escape to no refuge and then to the sole settlement.
75:30 repeats the Lord-directed destination but changes settlement into a drive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed flight, absent refuge, fixed settlement, sovereignty, and driving; I map spinal support onto spatial and social support. The alternative is to keep فاقرة bodily and treat the escape sequence as a separate theme.

changed_reading.after: The calamity also breaks every supporting route of evasion, leaving the affected self exposed and compelled toward a single destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: What the person advanced and delayed is reported, and the later action chain names non-verification, denial, and turning away. The reciprocal branch of ف ع ل allows the anonymous act done to the face to be read as the returning counterpart of acts previously sent forward.

activation_trace.role: Mutual action between two participants supplies the action-and-return architecture.
The back-breaking calamity is the severe returned event in that architecture.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies disclosure of the person's prior action history.
Advancing something forward gives prior deeds a trajectory toward the later encounter.
Deferring to a later time supplies the complementary residue of what was not advanced.
Making truth real in action defines the positive deed explicitly withheld in the sequence.
Contradiction of truth supplies the enacted denial whose counterpart can return.
Turning away and withdrawing completes the initiating action pattern.

structural_cues: 75:13 says the person is informed of what was advanced and delayed.
75:31-32 gives a balanced action chain: did not verify or pray, but denied and turned away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an action record and a reciprocal-action branch for the focus verb; I supply the arrow that prior deeds return as the act done to the face. A live alternative is a one-way consequence with no reciprocity in the verb itself.

changed_reading.before: An external calamity is done to the face.
changed_reading.after: The face recognizes the calamity as the enacted return of what its owner advanced, deferred, denied, and turned away from.

context_deltas.mechanism: Persistent attachment to what is accelerated and immediate is paired with leaving what comes later. The need and inner-greed branches of ف ق ر convert that temporal choice into a deficit: the face anticipates the poverty produced by its own preference structure.

activation_trace.role: Certainty after an indication lets the face recognize the accumulated result of the temporal choice.
Material need supplies the objective deficit reached at the later horizon.
Inner poverty as greed makes persistent appetite the mechanism that generates the deficit.
That which comes after supplies the abandoned temporal horizon.
Acceleration and putting first supply the short-horizon preference.
Love fixed in the heart makes the preference affectively persistent rather than accidental.
Leaving a thing behind supplies the act that creates the later lack.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 is a direct contrast: loving the immediate and leaving the later.
75:24-25 follows immediately, so the grim face is the first displayed result of that contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attachment, acceleration, abandonment, and poverty branches; I infer the causal arrow from short-horizon love to later deprivation. The alternative keeps فاقرة solely as bodily calamity and treats 75:20-21 as motivation rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The face expects an externally imposed disaster.
changed_reading.after: The face recognizes a self-produced destitution: its attachment to the immediate has left it empty at the later horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah frame alternates assembly and separation: dispersed hard bones can be gathered and made whole, the focus predicts a spinal break, separation follows, and the closing sequence returns to decreed formation, creation, transformation, life, and death. The passive فاقرة is therefore controlled disassembly within a claimed capacity to reconstitute, not uncontrolled annihilation.

activation_trace.role: Bringing an act into being makes the break a performed transformation rather than accidental collapse.
Segmented vertebrae and a broken back provide the disassembled structure at the model's center.
The back-breaking calamity supplies the destructive phase of the controlled transformation.
Joining dispersed parts into one whole supplies the inverse operation to structural breakage.
Hard bone makes the reassembled material anatomically continuous with the focus spine.
Capability that reaches effective action supplies control over both disassembly and reassembly.
Integrity and completion in the thing itself supply the restored state after gathering.
Scattering or separating into parts supplies the explicit inverse of gathering.
Measuring a thing and carrying its decree through supplies an ordered formation process.
Origination and bringing creation into being supply constructive agency after separation.
Transforming something into a state supplies deliberate differentiation within creation.
Possession of living spirit supplies the state that reconstitution can restore.
Loss of power and life supplies the state explicitly set against renewed life.

structural_cues: 75:3-4 asserts gathering bones and restoring even the extremities before the focus sequence.
75:37-40 closes with ordered generation and a capability question about giving life to the dead.
75:25-29 places spinal break and separation between those two constructive frames.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, bodily integrity, separation, ordered creation, and renewed life; I infer that one controlling agency links these operations and that the passive focus event is a disassembly phase. A live alternative reads فاقرة juridically or affectively, without material decomposition.

changed_reading.before: The back-breaking calamity is terminal destruction.
changed_reading.after: The calamity is a controlled dismantling by a power framed as able to gather, reform, and reanimate the same embodied person.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries فاقرة through its hollowing and piercing branches rather than the direct calamity branch; it remains anchored in the focus noun and passive verb and gains a coherent fissure-to-wound network from packet roots, but downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not assert a literal facial perforation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَاقِرَةٌ carries hollow, outlet, incision, and piercing branches, while يُفْعَلَ بِهَا permits a procedure performed upon the resolved facial referent.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to undergo an act supplies the performed breaching operation.
A ground hollow or water outlet supplies the opened cavity and outlet image.
An incision, notch, or piercing turns the cavity into an active breach.
A broad fissure and bursting forth supply the breach's opening movement.
Ground sinking supplies collapse into the newly opened depth.
A bodily part opening away from what adjoined it supplies tissue-level separation.
Cutting flesh and scoring a wound make the breach explicitly bodily.
A wound reaching the cavity or brain supplies the breach's extreme depth.

changed_reading.before: فاقرة is a generic back-breaking disaster.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a breaching event that opens, sinks, separates, and wounds the embodied surface on which it is performed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus ف ع ل to the fatherhood-and-nurture inventory, not the morphology of يفعل itself; it remains formally resolvable and anchored at the focus verb, but downstream prose must call it a form-distant packet activation and never present nurture as a lexical gloss of يفعل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb يُفْعَلَ has a packet-authorized non-dominant mapped target, root_000007, whose B001 branch is parental causation, correction, and nurture.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split target's fatherhood and parental nurture image colors the passive act as severe corrective remaking.
The back-breaking calamity preserves the destructive severity that the corrective coloring must not erase.
Correction, nurture, and bringing to completion give the form-distant coloring a same-surah relational analogue.
Origination and creation supply the remaking side of the severe process.
Effective capability supplies the power that could carry corrective remaking through.

changed_reading.before: The unnamed passive act is purely destructive.
changed_reading.after: At maximum exploratory distance, the back-breaking act can be carried as a severe corrective re-forming within the surah's creation frame.

strongest_changes: The face context resolves بها and turns تظن from private fear into a visible verdict already carried by the grim expression.
The repeated ظن at bodily separation shifts the focus toward certainty after signs and opens a continuous axial-collapse and forced-transport sequence.
The action record and reciprocal ف ع ل branch make the calamity available as the returned form of prior deeds.
The immediate-versus-later contrast strengthens the poverty branches of فاقرة as self-produced deprivation.
The surah-wide assembly, creation, and revival frame revises back-breaking destruction into controlled disassembly within a capacity to reconstitute.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package kept distant mechanisms active at once: facial display, self-witness, failed escape, temporal appetite, deed-return, and the assembly-to-revival frame. Nearest context alone would mostly have yielded facial dread followed by dying.
remaining_uncertainties: The certainty and weak-supposition branches of ظ ن ن remain simultaneously viable.
The direct calamity and spinal branches of ف ق ر are strongest, while poverty and material breach remain real but less secure activations.
Reciprocity and the identity of the passive actor are reader-supplied arrows rather than explicit grammar in 75:25.
The corrective-remaking outlier depends on a highly form-distant non-dominant mapped root and requires explicit containment.
